    Finiteness of bounded ray tackles #

    Package the bounded-chain consequence of the BGRS no-infinite-chain hypothesis and derive finiteness of the full dependent tackle type. The bound is also transported through zero-ideal quotients.

            class LargeIndecomposable.HasBoundedRayChains (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] :
            Type

            Finite bounded form of the no-infinite-chain consequence used in BGRS: the lengths of both alternating chain shapes admit one common bound.

            • bound : ℕ
            • hook_lt {m : ℕ} : Nonempty (RayHookChain m) → m < bound C
            • cohook_lt {m : ℕ} : Nonempty (RayCohookChain m) → m < bound C
